recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, two-tone graphic featuring three male faces rendered in extreme high-contrast white against a solid black background. The faces are arranged in a slight diagonal descent from left to right, appearing as if emerging from deep shadow. The overall aesthetic is gritty, utilizing heavy black ink and minimal mid-tones to create a dramatic, soulful mood.
coreVisualRelationships: Faces emerge from a dominant black void
Tight horizontal alignment of heads across the upper third
Extreme binary contrast between light and dark
Text anchored to the top edge, spanning the full width
coreInvariants: Pure black and white color palette
Loss of detail in shadows to create abstract shapes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three heads occupy the upper 40% of the frame, scaled to appear as a unified group.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face, which is slightly larger and more centered than the others.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold header text down to the faces, then into the expansive black negative space below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bottom 60% of the composition is almost entirely solid black, providing a heavy visual base.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black background and shadow areas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/light grey for highlights and facial features.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast with no gradients.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weight with no modulation

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a small margin from the heads

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all primary information to maintain graphic impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the original.
Provides the extreme verticality and tight counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, two-tone black and white image of three men's faces. Use a threshold effect so only the highlights are visible in white against a deep black background. Arrange the faces in the upper half of the frame. Apply a vintage, weathered paper texture with scratches and edge wear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text across the top edge using an ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif font in white. The text should be tightly kerned and justified to span the width of the image.

verificationChecks: Are the faces rendered as high-contrast shapes without mid-tones?
Is the text extra-bold and condensed?
Is there a visible distressed/vintage texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones are present in the faces
Verify text is perfectly horizontal and top-aligned
Check that the bottom half of the image remains predominantly black
Confirm the texture looks like physical paper wear rather than digital noise
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast threshold portraiture + ultra-bold condensed header + distressed monochrome finish.
